_about: The performance tiers. Each tier: a label and line for Settings, settings laid over the theme (a value replaces, {"min": n} keeps the lower, {"scale": f} multiplies), css switches the hub and apps turn into html.perf-<name> classes (no-blur: no backdrop blur; calm: no theme crossfade, no wallpaper drift, no clock shimmer), and the default for a live wallpaper and a companion that do not declare their own lighter (live: "" as is, "still" one frame, "off" the still picture, or {fps, res} factors; companion: "", "still" or "off"). Themes, layouts, glass and motion styles declare their own fallback on top of this.

full.label: Full
full.about: Every effect as the theme and Settings set it.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.about: The live wallpaper draws at half the rate and a smaller size, half the particles, no frosted blur behind panels, no beat on the 3D wallpaper.

light.label: Light
light.about: A plain version of the same theme: the live wallpaper stands still, the companion sits still, no particles, visualiser, 3D wallpaper, blur, shadows or drifting wallpaper; looping animations play once and pages draw at most 30 frames a second.
